# L0nmf

SPARSE FACTORIZATION · LOG-CONCAVE PROFILES

Sparse factors.\
Interpretable signals.
======================

Sparse nonnegative matrix factorization, log-concave profiles and
flexible observation models.

[Get started
↗](https://tomwenseleers.github.io/L0nmf/articles/log-concave-nmf.md)[Explore
the methods](https://tomwenseleers.github.io/L0nmf/reference/index.md)

R · Local likelihood updates · Full spectra · Constant & varying PSFs

![L0nmf hex logo showing a sparse matrix factorized into profiles and
spectral loadings](logo-dark.svg)

[**Sparse rank**Recover a parsimonious set of nonnegative
components](https://tomwenseleers.github.io/L0nmf/reference/splogconNMF.md)
[**Peak shapes**Log-concave profiles and constant or time-varying
PSFs](https://tomwenseleers.github.io/L0nmf/reference/estimate_psf.md)
[**5 families**Gaussian, Poisson, quasi-Poisson, negative binomial and
Gamma](https://tomwenseleers.github.io/L0nmf/articles/log-concave-nmf.md)

L0nmf is part of a focused three-package toolkit:
[L0glm](https://tomwenseleers.github.io/L0glm/) supplies fast sparse GLM
selection, [L0nmf](https://tomwenseleers.github.io/L0nmf/) supplies
sparse factorization and PSF estimation, and
[GCMSprime](https://tomwenseleers.github.io/GCMSprime/) turns those
methods into a chromatographic workflow.

## Installation

``` r

install.packages("remotes")
remotes::install_github("tomwenseleers/L0nmf/L0nmf")
```

## Recover profiles and spectra

``` r

library(L0glm)
library(L0nmf)
data(GCMS_data1)
X <- convmatrix(convkernel("gaussian", 65L, list(sigma=8)), nrow(GCMS_data1))
fit <- splogconNMF(X, GCMS_data1, background=matrix(1,nrow(X),1),
                  family=quasipoisson("identity"), precluster=16L,
                  correlation="none")
fit
GIC(fit)
matplot(as.matrix(fit$H), type="l", lty=1, xlab="Scan", ylab="Elution profile")
```

The factors retain every original outcome channel. Profiles have unit
area, nonnegative spectra carry their intensities, and a smooth
unpenalized background captures baseline variation. Selection and fusion
use a parsimonious rank criterion with local likelihood updates.

![Recovered log-concave profiles and
spectra](reference/figures/gcms-data1-profiles-spectra.png)

Recovered log-concave profiles and spectra

The [worked
example](https://tomwenseleers.github.io/L0nmf/articles/log-concave-nmf.md)
shows the model, likelihood and local updates in detail.

## Methods and applications

- [Sparse log-concave factorization and its mathematical
  model](https://tomwenseleers.github.io/L0nmf/articles/log-concave-nmf.md)
- [Constant and time-varying
  PSFs](https://tomwenseleers.github.io/L0nmf/reference/estimate_psf.md)
- [Blind
  deconvolution](https://tomwenseleers.github.io/L0nmf/reference/L0glm_blind_deco.md)
- [Simulated
  chromatograms](https://tomwenseleers.github.io/L0nmf/reference/simulate_GCMS.md)
- [GC/MS input, output and reports in
  GCMSprime](https://tomwenseleers.github.io/GCMSprime/articles/gcms-deconvolution.html)

Gaussian, Poisson, quasi-Poisson, negative-binomial and Gamma
observation models are supported for identity-link nonnegative signals.
The help pages describe aggregation, temporal dispersion, censored
observations and the full objective.

[`L0BestRankGNMF()`](https://tomwenseleers.github.io/L0nmf/reference/L0BestRankGNMF.md)
provides an experimental general factorization method. Its algorithm is
being developed separately from the validated local log-concave
workflow.

## Citation and acknowledgements

An article describing these methods is in preparation. Please cite the
package and the methodological sources linked in the help pages when
using this work. OpenAI Codex/GPT-6 Astra and 6.1 Sol assisted code
optimization, refactoring and documentation; the authors developed the
key ideas and take responsibility for the work.

# Package index

## All functions

- [`estimate_psf()`](https://tomwenseleers.github.io/L0nmf/reference/estimate_psf.md)
  : Estimate constant or time-varying point spread functions
- [`estimate_psf_from_std()`](https://tomwenseleers.github.io/L0nmf/reference/estimate_psf_from_std.md)
  : Estimate a time-varying PSF matrix from an alkane ladder TIC
- [`estimate_signal_noise()`](https://tomwenseleers.github.io/L0nmf/reference/estimate_signal_noise.md)
  : Estimate a shared noise model for ordered multichannel signals
- [`GCMS_data1`](https://tomwenseleers.github.io/L0nmf/reference/GCMS_data1.md)
  : GC/MS Chromatogram Section - Cuticular Hydrocarbon Profile of a
  Cataglyphis iberica Ant Queen
- [`GCMS_data2`](https://tomwenseleers.github.io/L0nmf/reference/GCMS_data2.md)
  : GC/MS Chromatogram Section - Beer Headspace Volatiles
- [`L0BestRankGNMF()`](https://tomwenseleers.github.io/L0nmf/reference/L0BestRankGNMF.md)
  : L0-Penalised Generalised Best-Rank NMF
- [`L0glm_blind_deco()`](https://tomwenseleers.github.io/L0nmf/reference/L0glm_blind_deco.md)
  : Alternating sparse L0 glm powered blind deconvolution
- [`L0glm_deco_estkernel()`](https://tomwenseleers.github.io/L0nmf/reference/L0glm_deco_estkernel.md)
  : Estimate the PSF given a spike train estimate via L0-penalised GLMs
- [`L0glm_sparse_deco()`](https://tomwenseleers.github.io/L0nmf/reference/L0glm_sparse_deco.md)
  : Sparse deconvolution with a fixed PSF via L0-penalised GLMs
- [`log_conc_smooth()`](https://tomwenseleers.github.io/L0nmf/reference/log_conc_smooth.md)
  : Log-concave spline smoothing of a discrete convolution kernel
  estimate
- [`simulate_GCMS()`](https://tomwenseleers.github.io/L0nmf/reference/simulate_GCMS.md)
  : Simulate synthetic GC-MS chromatograms with ground-truth signal +
  background
- [`residuals(`*`<splogconNMF>`*`)`](https://tomwenseleers.github.io/L0nmf/reference/splogconNMF.md)
  [`splogconNMF()`](https://tomwenseleers.github.io/L0nmf/reference/splogconNMF.md)
  [`fitted(`*`<splogconNMF>`*`)`](https://tomwenseleers.github.io/L0nmf/reference/splogconNMF.md)
  [`nobs(`*`<splogconNMF>`*`)`](https://tomwenseleers.github.io/L0nmf/reference/splogconNMF.md)
  [`coef(`*`<splogconNMF>`*`)`](https://tomwenseleers.github.io/L0nmf/reference/splogconNMF.md)
  [`logLik(`*`<splogconNMF>`*`)`](https://tomwenseleers.github.io/L0nmf/reference/splogconNMF.md)
  [`AIC(`*`<splogconNMF>`*`)`](https://tomwenseleers.github.io/L0nmf/reference/splogconNMF.md)
  [`BIC(`*`<splogconNMF>`*`)`](https://tomwenseleers.github.io/L0nmf/reference/splogconNMF.md)
  [`GIC(`*`<splogconNMF>`*`)`](https://tomwenseleers.github.io/L0nmf/reference/splogconNMF.md)
  [`EBIC(`*`<splogconNMF>`*`)`](https://tomwenseleers.github.io/L0nmf/reference/splogconNMF.md)
